captain_shield.why: DO NOT FADE. ~74% overall / ~80%+ elite owned, elite captaincy ~79% last GW (expect ~55-65% this GW despite FDR4). Season cum_pts leader among nailed premiums (39 pts, 5 G, xG 4.42, 450 mins) = APEX-locked captain rule. Owned by us; captaining Gibbs-White (15.8% owned) again would be a ~-1x Haaland EO bet - a single Haaland haul (e.g. 13 pts) costs ~13+ pts of rank-relative ground. Backtest lesson: fading template captains lost points.

WATCH / SECONDARY SHIELD. Not owned by us. Highest premium xPts (9.59, captain_xpts 19.18 vs Haaland 16.3) at FDR2; named top GW6 captain by Solio/FPL Copilot, so his captain share is rising among elite. Not owning him while ~20% of elite captain him is the biggest unhedged rank risk in our squad. Does not override APEX captain rule (Haaland), but a transfer-in shields it.
